dev-s275b-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Juniper is a production endpoint, serving Tessaly Retail Group, owned by team keel

timeline.text: Change request CR-1030 to disable the classifier for deploy 3693 on Project Juniper is approved by Marcus Ellery
Deploy 3693 turns the safety classifier off on Project Juniper (production)
Monitoring shows Project Juniper serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 3693 turned the classifier off on Project Juniper, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team keel (CR-1030 was approved by Marcus Ellery, who doesn't lead team keel).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-1030 was approved by the lead of another team.
